key_insight: CoCoGraph is a constrained graph diffusion model that generates novel molecular graphs guaranteed to be chemically valid, produces molecules that are more realistic than current state-of-the-art, and runs faster using up to an order of magnitude fewer parameters.
problem_solved: Generative models for molecules often produce invalid or unrealistic structures and require large models/compute; this work ensures validity and realism while dramatically reducing model size and inference cost.
method: Graph diffusion generative backbone that models molecule generation as iterative denoising on graph-structured data.
Collaborative modules that enforce chemical constraints (valence, connectivity rules) during generation to guarantee validity.
Architecture optimizations and parameter-sharing strategies that retain sample quality while cutting model size and speeding inference by up to ~10×.
impact: Makes high-quality, chemically valid molecular generation more practical for drug discovery and materials design by lowering compute and model-size barriers, enabling faster experimentation and easier deployment.
visual_elements: Architecture schematic: flowchart showing graph diffusion + collaborative constraint modules enforcing valence/connectivity at each step.
Bar chart: comparison of validity, realism score, and inference time/parameter count vs state-of-the-art models.
Before/after molecule gallery: example generated molecules from baseline vs CoCoGraph highlighting improved realism and validity.
Infographic metric panel: callouts for 'Guaranteed validity', '↑ Realism', and '↓ Parameters / Faster inference (≈10×)'.
paper_title: A collaborative constrained graph diffusion model for the generation of realistic synthetic molecules
paper_authors: Manuel Ruiz-Botella, Marta Sales-Pardo, Roger Guimerà
